description: This file contains the implementation of a web service class (SugarWebServiceImplv3) for SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, providing various methods for login, retrieving module info, layout, recent views, searching, and relationships. It extends a base web service class and utilizes utility and core classes to facilitate CRM operations via SOAP.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceImplv3
classes.description: Implementation class for SuiteCRM/SugarCRM REST web services providing login, metadata retrieval, search, and relationship APIs.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login, initializes session, and returns user info and session ID.

methods.name: get_module_fields_md5
methods.description: Returns MD5 hashes of module vardef definitions for change detection.

methods.name: get_server_info
methods.description: Provides server version, flavor, and current GMT time.

methods.name: get_module_layout
methods.description: Retrieves layout metadata for specified modules, views, and types.

methods.name: get_module_layout_md5
methods.description: Returns MD5 hashes of layout metadata for modules.

methods.name: get_available_modules
methods.description: Lists modules available to the logged-in user based on specified filter.

methods.name: get_last_viewed
methods.description: Fetches recently viewed records for specified modules.

methods.name: get_upcoming_activities
methods.description: Retrieves upcoming activities like calls, meetings, and tasks.

methods.name: search_by_module
methods.description: Performs a search across specified modules with filters, returning matching records.

methods.name: get_relationships
methods.description: Fetches related records for a given module record, including relationship data.
